name: buboes
description: Buboes, the Warbringer, Horseman of War: a rider in black spiked plate with crimson plates and bone-white spikes, a horned black closed helm with a glowing red T-shaped visor slit and a tattered black cloak streaming behind him, raising a huge notched blood-red greatsword high in his RIGHT hand on the screen-left side, riding a dark red war horse with a glowing red eye, a fiery red mane and tail, dark hooves and ragged black barding trimmed in crimson
hands: the red greatsword stays in the rider's right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand holds the reins on the screen-right side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the red war horse throws its head up and shies back toward the upper-left, its front hooves off the ground; the black-armoured rider jolts back in the saddle, his horned helm snapping back, arms flung out, the red greatsword still in his right hand

death.1: stagger: the red war horse rears back toward the upper-left, head thrown back; the black-armoured rider is thrown back in the saddle, arms flung up, the red glow of his visor flickering
death.2: the red war horse's forelegs fold and it drops onto its knees, head sinking; the black-armoured rider pitches back in the saddle, arms up, his horned helm tipped back
death.3: the red war horse sinks down onto its chest, head sinking, its red eye dimming; the black-armoured rider sags in the saddle, arms dropping, his visor's red glow dimming
death.4: the red war horse sinks fully onto its belly with its legs folded under it, its neck lowering forward toward the lower-right; the black-armoured rider, still in the saddle, slumps forward over its neck, the red greatsword slipping from his hand, his visor gone dark
death.5: the red war horse lying collapsed on its belly, legs folded under it, its head lying on the ground toward the lower-right, its eye dark; the black-armoured rider slumped forward over the neck, arms hanging down, his horned helm bowed and its visor dark, the red greatsword on the ground beside the red war horse's head
death.7: corpses: the red war horse lying still, collapsed on its belly with its head on the ground, the black-armoured rider slumped forward over its neck, his visor dark, the red greatsword on the ground beside the head
